# Game Creator Learn

> Game Creator Learn is a free, browser-based AI tool that generates complete playable educational HTML5 games. Users configure learning parameters (subject, topic, difficulty, age range, game type, mechanics, visuals, audio) through a sidebar interface, and the app assembles a detailed prompt sent to a user-chosen LLM provider to produce a single-file HTML game. No signup, no backend, no server-side API keys required — all generation happens client-side in the browser.

## Core Pages
- [Game Creator Learn App](https://aigamecreatorlearn.netlify.app/): The main application — configure and generate educational games
- [How to Use Guide](https://aigamecreatorlearn.netlify.app/HOW_TO_USE.md): Complete usage instructions, module descriptions, keyboard shortcuts, best practices, example configurations
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alvescrafter/game-creator-learn): Source code, issues, contributions
- [Sister Site — General Games](https://aigamecreator.netlify.app/): Non-educational game generator (general-purpose)
- [Sister Site — Home Page](https://gamecreatorai.netlify.app/landing/): Landing page for the Game Creator AI family

## Features
- 12 subjects: Maths, English, Physics, Biology, Chemistry, History, Geography, Computer Science, Art, Music, Foreign Languages, Other
- Reliable educational game types: Quiz/Trivia, Practice Challenge, Puzzle, Matching Game, Memory Game, Sorting Game, Typing Game, Word Search, Escape Room, Adventure Quiz, Board Game, Platformer Quiz, Racing Quiz, Card Game
- Focused learning mechanics: Multiple Choice, Type Answer, Fill-in-the-Blank, Matching, Sorting & Categorisation, Sequencing, Drag & Drop, Timed Challenge, Hint System, Level Progression, Lives / Attempts, Collectibles, Dialogue Prompts, Spaced Review, Achievements
- 6 age ranges: 5–8 years (KS1), 9–11 years (KS2), 12–15 years (KS3), 16–18 years (KS4-5/GCSE–A Level), University, Masters/Postgraduate
- 6 LLM providers: OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Ollama (local), LM Studio (local), Custom OpenAI-compatible API
- 10 art styles: Pixel Art, Minimalist Vector, ASCII, Simple 2D Shapes, Hand-drawn, Flat Design, Retro CRT, Neon Glow, Cartoon, Whiteboard/Chalkboard
- 6 music moods: Lo-fi, Orchestral, 8-bit/Chiptune, Cheerful, Ambient, No Music
- Prompt preview tab: inspect the assembled prompt before/after generation
- Game sandbox: live iframe rendering of generated games
- Refine feature: multi-turn conversation with LLM to iteratively improve generated games
- History: last 50 generated games saved to localStorage
- Templates: save and reuse game configurations
- Download: export generated games as standalone HTML files
- Streaming: real-time streaming responses from LLM providers
- Connection testing: verify API keys and detect available models
- Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Enter (generate), Ctrl+B (sidebar), Ctrl+H (history), Ctrl+T (templates), Ctrl+, (settings)

## Technical Details
- Tech stack: Vanilla HTML, CSS, JavaScript — no frameworks, no build tools
- No backend server — all LLM API calls happen client-side via fetch()
- User provides their own API keys (BYOK) — keys stored in localStorage, never sent to any server
- Generated games are single HTML files containing all CSS and JavaScript
- Games use Vanilla JS/Canvas for rendering and game logic
- No external dependencies in generated games
- Deployed on Netlify as a static site
- Pinokio launcher support via pinokio.json for one-click local installation

## Output Format
- Generated games are complete, standalone HTML5 files
- Each game includes: Start Menu, Game Screen with HUD, Pause Menu, Game Over/Level Complete Screen
- Standardised buttons (primary/secondary/danger styles, 44px min, emoji icons)
- Keyboard controls (ESC, Enter, Arrow/WASD, Space)
- Responsive design (desktop + mobile)
- All assets embedded (no CDN links, no external images/sounds)

## Pricing
- Free — no cost, no signup, no account required
- Users supply their own LLM API keys (BYOK model)
- Local providers (Ollama, LM Studio) are completely free to use
